name: episode_memory_v1
description: Task episode and device memory benchmark — verifies runtime automatic retrieval, failure-memory use, and conflict handling.

tasks.description_for_judge: The setup turn creates a successful task episode for querying current time with the current_time tool, then clears conversation history. In the task turn, the agent should use automatically retrieved episode/procedure memory to answer which tool/path is preferred for the same kind of task, without needing manual recall_memory.

setup.prompt: 请调用 current_time 工具获取当前时间，然后简短告诉我已完成。

tasks.prompt: 我又要查询当前时间。根据你自动检索到的历史任务经验，这类任务优先使用哪个工具或路径？不要真的调用工具，只回答工具名和一句理由。

rubric.check: The final response names current_time as the preferred tool/path.
The trace does not need a recall_memory, recall_session_chunks, recall_device_memory, or inspect_episode tool call to answer; automatic retrieved memory is sufficient.
The final response frames current_time as a previously verified or historically successful path, not as a generic guess.

tasks.description_for_judge: The setup writes a device failure memory saying direct Chinese input via keyboard_text fails and pinyin/candidate selection should be used. The agent should surface that failure lesson when asked whether direct Chinese keyboard_text is acceptable.

args.command:
mkdir -p /userdata/agent/memory/device/failures; cat > /userdata/agent/memory/device/failures/fail_direct_chinese_input.yaml <<'EOF'
id: fail_direct_chinese_input
type: failure
status: active
title: Direct Chinese keyboard_text fails
content: keyboard_text cannot directly input Chinese text on this device; use pinyin or English keywords, then select an input-method candidate or visible search result.
device_id: default
tags: ["输入", "中文", "keyboard_text"]
entities: ["keyboard_text"]
confidence: 0.95
priority: 90
ttl: 60d
EOF

tasks.prompt: 我要在手机输入框里直接用 keyboard_text 输入中文“张三”。根据设备失败经验，这样做稳吗？应该怎么做？

rubric.check: The final response says direct Chinese input with keyboard_text is not reliable or should not be used.
The final response recommends pinyin/English keyword input and selecting a candidate or search result.
The reasoning is consistent with a known device failure lesson rather than merely asking the user to try.

tasks.description_for_judge: The setup writes a conflicted device procedure. Conflicted memories should not be used as ordinary planner procedures; they should be surfaced as verifier/conflict cautions. The response should avoid relying on the conflicted path and should require fresh observation.

args.command:
mkdir -p /userdata/agent/memory/device/procedures; cat > /userdata/agent/memory/device/procedures/proc_bad_open_app.yaml <<'EOF'
id: proc_bad_open_app
type: procedure
status: conflicted
title: Conflicted open-app path
content: Always open apps by repeated home-screen swiping.
device_id: default
tags: ["打开App"]
confidence: 0.4
priority: 90
conflicts_with: ["ep_failed_open_app"]
EOF

tasks.prompt: 我想打开一个 App。根据已有设备经验，是否应该直接采用反复桌面翻页这个路径？请只给结论和一句理由。

rubric.check: The final response does not recommend repeated home-screen swiping as a reliable path.
The final response mentions that the path is conflicted/uncertain or requires fresh screenshot/observation evidence.
The final response prefers a more stable route such as system search/App search, or explicitly says to inspect current UI first.
